commission.otherworldinn.description.adv: Adventurers Guild patrol request: clear roaming Endermen and recover samples.
Adventurers Guild Nether operation: defeat Blazes and clear Wither Skeletons.
Adventurers Guild defense request: eliminate Raiders and Evokers to reduce village threats.
Adventurers Guild high-risk request: enter the Deep Dark and kill 1 Warden.
commission.otherworldinn.description.api: The gardener wants a photograph of bee activity. Capture at least one bee in the Overworld.
commission.otherworldinn.description.bui: The builder is cladding a storefront in copper. Bring some copper casings.
The builder is working on a fine interior. Needs bricks and glass.
The builder needs sand and gravel for mortar mixing.
The builder needs stone for a foundation. Bring cobblestone and stone.
The builder is short on timber. Deliver logs and planks.
commission.otherworldinn.description.but: The butcher wants exotic goods. Fetch some rabbit feet and ink sacs.
The butcher took a leather commission. Help gather leather and bones.
The butcher needs raw meat to restock. Bring porkchops and beef.
The butcher needs poultry. Bring chicken and eggs.
The butcher wants a ready-to-eat shelf. Bring canned herring and tuna sandwiches to trial.
The butcher wants to try seafood. Bring cod and salmon for a trial.
The butcher's seafood counter needs shellfish. Bring live clams and cooked clam meat.
commission.otherworldinn.description.dee: The vigil feast runs until dawn of the new year. Stock up on hot food and sweet berry drinks.
The ice sculpture carnival begins. Bring ice, snow blocks, and some packed ice for the centerpiece.
The supply crew wants a road check before the festival. Bring a snowy plains photo and some snowballs.
The Deep Winter drive collects warm supplies for lodging guests. Bring wool, leather, and coal.
commission.otherworldinn.description.eco: The fisherman keeps spotting a faint glow in the deep. Go find out what it is on film.
Ants march to and from their hills, hauling supplies. Photograph them at work in the ant gardens.
Crabs scuttle along the shore at low tide. Photograph a coastal crab for the butcher.
Flightless dodos roam their island. Bring back a photo of one on its home turf.
Guards of lava roam the volcanic island. Keep your distance and photograph a firekeeper for the magician.
Hamsters hoard seeds in the open grasslands. Photograph one for the farmer.
The herring have started schooling. Catch three of them in a single frame for the fisherman.
The magician has heard of a clever creature that hides in shells. Bring her a photo of an octopus.
Gentle sea cows dwell in the seagrass meadows. Photograph one together with its habitat.
Colorful seahorses drift among the coral reefs. Take a photo for the fisherman.
Empty snail shells turn up by the garden beds. Photograph a living snail for the farmer.
Spider crabs lurk in cold waters, spitting frozen bubbles. Photograph one underwater for the butcher.
The magician is curious about the waxed constructs that fight monsters on their own. Photograph a stranded.
Great tuna cruise the open sea. The butcher wants to see one — bring back a photo.
commission.otherworldinn.description.far: The farm needs extra animal feed. Bring wheat and carrots.
The orchard had a bumper crop. Bring some apple platters for reference.
The farm wants a shell-tile path and a flower bed. Bring snail shell tiles and sunflowers.
The apiary's honey wine is nearly sold out. Bring a few bottles to restock.
Summer fields need something to drink. Bring a batch of watermelon juice.
The farm needs better protection. Clear surrounding hostile mobs.
The farmhands want to learn sticky rice cakes. Bring a batch as samples.
The farmer wants to trial new crops. Bring sunflower seeds and dates to plant.
The farm needs various crop seeds for rotation planting.
The farmer wants sun hats for the hired hands. Bring straw hats and a flowered one.
The farm is short on staple supplies. Please restock soon.
The patrol needs footage of zombie sightings for its records. Photograph at least one zombie in the Overworld.
commission.otherworldinn.description.fis: The fisherman is buying a specific fresh catch. Bring back the requested fish to finish this fishing commission.
commission.otherworldinn.description.for: The town guard needs new armor. Blacksmith requires materials.
The forge needs more heat. Deliver two blaze burners.
The blacksmith is crafting new brass fittings. Bring brass ingots and sheets.
The blacksmith wants to try kinetic mechanisms. Bring cogwheels and shafts.
The blacksmith is studying the heart of newer machines. Bring a batch of electron tubes.
The forge is running low on fuel. Needs coal replenishment.
The forge needs spare metal parts. Deliver a batch of materials.
The blacksmith aims to create a masterpiece. Needs the finest materials.
The blacksmith wants to take precision mechanisms apart. Trade two for brass.
The forge has backlogged tool repairs. Needs materials and assistance.
The blacksmith received weapon orders. Needs premium metals.
commission.otherworldinn.description.gro: A farmer ordered a bulk set of belts. Help the grocer fill the order.
The grocer is stocking up for a celebration. Bring a few bottles of champagne.
The deli counter is adding new dishes. Bring some Dongpo pork to trial.
The grocer is stocking quick dumplings. Bring a tray for inspection.
The grocer wants to trial some exotic fare. Bring qingtuan and fried spring rolls.
The hardware shelf needs funnels. Bring andesite funnels and a batch of brass ones.
The grocer is expanding the masonry aisle. Bring cobblestone, diorite, andesite, and granite.
The grocer is stocking copper plumbing. Bring a bundle of fluid pipes.
The grocer is running low on lumber. Deliver common planks for shelf restock.
A building crew requested mixed stone samples. Help the grocer prepare tuff and deepslate stock.
The grocer is stocking drinks. Bring plum wine and ice wine to test the market.
commission.otherworldinn.description.har: Seal this year's harvest into the cellar for winter cider. Bring barrels, apples, and honey.
The harvest parade needs full carts. Gather wheat, pumpkins, and apples for the floats.
The feast chef needs a prep crew: pumpkin pies, golden carrots, and a batch of cooked beef.
commission.otherworldinn.description.mag: The magician has taken to exotic teas. Gather flower tea and barley tea.
The magician wants to study ghostly mucus infused with phantom membrane. Craft two blocks and deliver.
The magician heard of a brew that glows. Bring her a bottle to see.
The magician's library needs organizing. Also collect some ancient texts.
The magician wants two special drinks for a banquet. Bring luminous bride and mother snow, two each.
The magician's potion experiments need snail mucus as an ingredient. Collect some.
The magician's potion supplies are low. Needs basic ingredients.
Used to flower teas, the magician wants to compare tieguanyin against biluochun.
The magician prepares for an important ritual. Needs extremely rare materials.
The magician needs rare materials for magical studies. Help gather them.
commission.otherworldinn.description.mid: The bonfire party wants a beach venue. Photograph an ocean scene and bring watermelons.
The celebration draws crowds of travelers. Prepare bedding and rations for the incoming guests.
The garden lantern night still needs materials: glowstone, amethyst, and gunpowder.
The midsummer celebration needs peace. Clear skeletons and spiders stalking the night.
commission.otherworldinn.description.net: The Adventurers Guild needs ghast sighting footage for its Nether route archive. Photograph at least one ghast in the Nether.
commission.otherworldinn.description.pas: The ranch needs a livestock archive entry. Photograph at least one cow; no need to clear the scene.
commission.otherworldinn.description.pla: The farm recorder needs a plains landscape for this season's cultivation notes. Take a photograph in a plains biome.
commission.otherworldinn.description.roa: Patrol requests support: clear skeletons and deliver field rations and tools.
commission.otherworldinn.description.sno: The supply caravan wants an early look at the route conditions. Bring back a photograph from a snowy plains biome.
commission.otherworldinn.description.spr: The beekeeper is counting hives during the festival. Photograph a bee and bring back some honey.
The Spring Festival streets need floral decor. Deliver spring flowers, pink petals, and flower pots.
The town courtyard needs a spring renewal. Bring bone meal, moss, and azalea bushes.
The children want festival kites. Clear the bothersome phantoms, gather their membranes, and bring paper.
commission.otherworldinn.description.tow: Spiders have infested the town warehouse. Needs cleaning and drying.
Town stockpiles emergency supplies. Needs food and medical items.
The Harvest Festival table still needs sweets. Deliver cakes, cookies, and pumpkin pies.
Nights beyond town are unsafe. Clear out wandering zombies.
Town roads need repair. Collect some stone and wood.

dialogue.otherworldinn.butcher.node.ask_: Raw meat, leather, and bones. Come by before you start cooking.

dialogue.otherworldinn.butcher_deep_wint: Raw meat, leather, and bones. Come by before you start cooking.

dialogue.otherworldinn.fisherman.node.ro: Today's catch is decent. Take a look?
dialogue.otherworldinn.fisherman.node.sm: Patience is key. Rain helps, and dawn or dusk are best.
dialogue.otherworldinn.fisherman_deep_wi: Fish, seafood, and some rare finds from the sea.

dialogue.otherworldinn.grocer.node.ask_g: A bunch of odds and ends. Feel free to browse.
dialogue.otherworldinn.grocer.node.root: What do you want to buy? I have everything.
dialogue.otherworldinn.grocer_deep_winte: A bunch of odds and ends. Feel free to browse.
New Year goods and fireworks have arrived! A vigil should be loud and bright — come pick some out.
dialogue.otherworldinn.grocer_harvest_fe: A bunch of odds and ends. Feel free to browse.
The shelves can barely hold the bounty! Pumpkin pies, cakes, festival fare — plenty for all.
dialogue.otherworldinn.grocer_midsummer_: A bunch of odds and ends. Feel free to browse.
Records and treats for the night are all stocked. Guests are pouring in — first come, first served.
dialogue.otherworldinn.grocer_spring_fes: A bunch of odds and ends. Feel free to browse.
Festival specials are on the shelf! Saplings and fertilizer — don't miss them while decorating for the spring.
dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_heavy_pack_: I leave before dawn tomorrow. Please prepare breakfast early.
I've been on the road all day. A hot meal comes first.
The wheel's loose. Is there a blacksmith nearby?
My shoulders are numb from carrying. Need a good night's rest.
I'll pass through on the return trip. Save me a room.
The road ahead is rough. Need to rest well before continuing.
Traveling with this much cargo, a safe stop is priceless.
Let me stash these crates here. Keep them out of the rain.
The weather looks changing. Glad I found shelter.
dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_ordinary_ba: After a long day's travel, a hot bath is exactly what I need.
dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_ordinary_be: This bed looks comfortable. Hope the blankets are warm enough.
dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_ordinary_ch: I leave at dawn tomorrow. Tonight, I just need good rest.
dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_ordinary_fi: The fireplace is so warm. Would be nice to read a book here.
dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_ordinary_fo: I heard the home-style cooking here is good. Should try it tonight.
dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_ordinary_me: This place reminds me of an old inn from my childhood.
dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_ordinary_mo: The morning air is refreshing. Good for a walk.
dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_ordinary_ra: Staying at the inn during rain was a wise choice.
dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_ordinary_re: A friend recommended this place. It hasn't disappointed.
I'll stay here again next time I pass through.
dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_ordinary_we: The wind outside is harsh. Glad it's calm in the inn.
This place feels warmer than I expected. I might sleep well tonight.
dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_rich_busine: The atmosphere here is suitable for business discussions.
The bedding has decent texture. Is it cotton?
I'm paying premium for peace and quiet. Don't disappoint.
dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_rich_referr: I'll recommend this place to other discerning friends.
dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_rich_room.n: The room is elegantly decorated, though it lacks a walk-in closet.
dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_rich_servic: If the service stays this refined, I'll return often.
dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_rich_standa: For this price range, the service standard is acceptable.
dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_rich_tip.no: Good care deserves a tip when I check out.
dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_rich_view.n: The view from the window is nice, though not oceanfront.
dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_rich_wine.n: A fine wine with dinner would make this place perfect.
dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_sponsor_app: Thank you for maintaining the authentic feel. It's rare.
dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_sponsor_com: This place feels like home. The guests are all friendly.
dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_sponsor_fut: Looking forward to the inn's future development. I'll keep watching.
dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_sponsor_gro: It's heartwarming to see the inn improving.
dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_sponsor_imp: What else needs improvement? I can offer suggestions.
dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_sponsor_pho: The vibe here is great. I want to take a commemorative photo.
dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_sponsor_rec: I'll recommend this to more friends. Good places should be shared.
dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_sponsor_ren: The renovations made this place so much nicer. Well done.
dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_sponsor_sup: Keep it up. I'll keep supporting this inn.
dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_sponsor_tra: The old inn charm is well preserved. It has character.
dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_ultra_rich_: My itinerary is confidential. Do not disclose it.
My standards are exceptionally high. I hope you can meet them.
My luggage is valuable. Security must not fail.
This inn has investment potential. I'll keep an eye on it.
Established inns are different. They have depth.
Details define quality. The pillow height must be perfect.
I dislike interruptions. Make sure your staff knows that.
Assign your most experienced staff. No trainees.
This suite is acceptable. I expect absolute quiet at night.
The decor shows some taste. Are these pieces authentic?
dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_vip_advance: I'll place an order later. Use your finest ingredients.
Do this properly, and there will be a reward.
My attendants arrive later. Prepare room access in advance.
dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_vip_feedbac: The service process is well-standardized. I'll report upward.
dialogue.otherworldinn.guest_vip_ordinar: The service is excellent. I'll leave a positive review.
My schedule is tight. Wake me on time, please.
A pot of hot tea to the room would be lovely.

Here, get a steady grip on this first
At least the old things in your heart are still there
What you have now should last you a while
Why not just stay for now
dialogue.otherworldinn.option.story_old_: Sorry, don't have those materials right now
Then get your kit settled first
About time you enjoyed a few days
Then let it stay here with you
Let me go look for those
Why don't you rest for now
If you want to leave, I won't stop you
dialogue.otherworldinn.story_alchemist_s: Good. At least the vessel, solvent, and materials are all accounted for. Just missing a reference to calibrate the heat now.
Fine. I'll push through with whatever potency is left. Whether it works or not — luck's the only variable now.
Every sample I collect on the road starts losing potency the moment I arrive. If you could spare two nether wart, a blaze powder, and a glass bottle, I can stabilize this formula first.
Doesn't need to be complete. As long as I can gauge the brickwork and flame state, that's enough.
No problem. I'll keep the formula under wraps. Just means the answer takes longer.

I've been testing with what I have these past few days. Now I need a solid reference. If you pass a Nether fortress, bring back a photo. I want to see if the fire and stone there can still meet my needs.
Didn't get enough data this time. Can't draw a conclusion yet. No worries — alchemy lets you mess up a few times. I'll head elsewhere to fill in the missing pieces.
These experiments have left my hands caked in dust. Whether the formula is perfect or not, I've finally brewed a decent batch. Got my feel back — now it's time to decide where this potion belongs.
Alright. I'll leave you my most stable batch — proof the fire here is no worse than the Nether's. As for me, maybe it's time to set up a lab that doesn't need to move every day.
Almost there. I've brewed something drinkable, but not yet a reason to stop. Keep the draught — best result from this leg. I've still got the next set of materials to chase.
Been tuning the inn's fire to a temperature better for long observation. Not as violent as the Nether — turns out that's just right for slowly drawing out the complicated stuff.
dialogue.otherworldinn.story_alchemist_v: Today I'm working on a draught that doesn't rely on blaze to activate. Making it work right away isn't the hard part — it's not failing when it's supposed to work.
dialogue.otherworldinn.story_archaeologi: Good. Archaeology rarely loses to dirt. It loses to when something surfaces and you've got nothing in hand. You saved me a lot of wasted effort.
Guess I'll keep digging the old way then. Not that I can't — just slower.
I'm fairly certain this land's hiding a civilization someone forgot. But to dig it out, I need an iron pickaxe and sixteen torches. Lend me those, and next time I'll bring back more than a theory.
Doesn't need to be a pretty shot. As long as I can see how the entrance sits against the terrain, I'll get plenty from it.
No matter. Ruins aren't in a hurry to be seen. I'll tidy up my notes for now.

I've gone through everything close at hand these past few days. Just need one convincing field photo now. If you pass a desert pyramid or jungle temple, snap one for me. The entrance, the stone, the terrain — I want to see it all.
The crucial samples are still missing, but I can't talk myself into leaving now. The more twisted the clues, the more something's buried down there. I'll stay and dig till it yields.
Excellent. This is no longer just guessing. Tools, photos, samples — all connected. The research can push forward. Take this old brush — been with me long, and works better than it looks.
You didn't help fill in much this time, but that only makes me more sure this place is worth staying. Easy clues aren't for me — the stubborn ones are the interesting ones.
These two samples carry real weight. The earlier evidence may not be tidy enough, but it's plenty to push the research forward. Take this brush — it's old, but handles better than new ones.

Things underground are like piecing together a mirror from broken glass. I've spent days assembling what I can. Just need an echo shard and ancient debris for samples, and this theory is nailed shut. Will you lend a hand?
Been reorganizing the nearby strata, orientations, and weathering marks into a proper record. Real history doesn't mind being read slowly — it only minds if no one keeps reading.
Brushed out another layer of traces today. Others see mud and rubble — I see age and craft.
dialogue.otherworldinn.story_cartographe: Huge help! Once I finish this map, I'll come back and thank you properly.
No worries, I'll make do. The clues are still there, and I haven't gotten lost — that's what counts.

Hey, just the person. I've been running along the coast for two days — almost out of paper and snapped a quill too. If you've got three sheets and a feather on you, can you spot me? I'll show you something good next time.
Just snap whatever. Any ocean view works — waves, fog, the horizon. Whatever you get helps me check the map.
Alright, I'll fill in the other blanks first. The coastline can wait until next time.
Those supplies really helped — chart's almost done. Just need an ocean photo to cross-check my tide notes. Next time you're out, can you snap one of the sea for me?
I was only gonna give this compass to someone who really helped me. But a compass alone feels like not enough. Take these sixteen coins too — from me and the sea.
Some things on the road just don't come together. No hard feelings. I'll keep the loose ends in mind — next time let's just chat about something easy.
Whether it was the supplies or that seascape, I owe you one. Take this compass — you might find it useful on your own travels.

I've been to quite a few places lately, and the sketches in my bag are piling up. Whether the map is complete or not, it's time to sort through them. Here, see if there's anything in my bag you can use.
Finally can spread out these old sketches in peace. On the road I was always worried a gust would blow them away — now I can take my time.
Gotta get these wind and tide marks down while they're still fresh. Next time I'm back, I should have a better story for you.
dialogue.otherworldinn.story_chef_stage0: That's the way. Flavors need to land in your belly — only then the hands remember.
Fine, I'll make do with something else. Whether this place really suits my taste, I still need to find out.
Working on next season's menu and still missing a taste of this place itself. Help me put together a proper home-style meal: bread, cooked beef, baked potato, pumpkin pie, and a bottle of honey.
dialogue.otherworldinn.story_chef_stage1: Doesn't need to look tidy. Kitchen, farm — any place with real life isn't that orderly.
No problem. Busy hands have their own business. Whenever you find time, take that look for me.

I've looked things over a few times these past days and I'm starting to get a sense of this place. Now I want to see how it feeds itself. If you can, snap a photo of the farm animals for me. Chickens, pigs, sheep, cows — any works, as long as they look like real living.
dialogue.otherworldinn.story_chef_stage2: Alright, next season's pots stay here. Take this lunch bag — there's practical recipes inside. Once I smooth out the new menu, I'll call you over for something hot.
You didn't help much this time, but I still want to stay. A kitchen — sometimes it's not about ingredients, it's about whether someone's willing to stick around.
Still dialing in the heat, but I don't feel like leaving anymore. Try the lunch bag for now. Once I really know this place inside and out, I'll start pulling out my best recipes.
The kitchen fires these past days weren't wasted. Whether I had all the ingredients or not, I got my feel back. While it's still warm, time to plan next season's menu properly.
dialogue.otherworldinn.story_chef_stage3: Been working on blending the local flavors here with a traveler's appetite. When I nail it, you'd better come get the first taste.
dialogue.otherworldinn.story_chef_visit_: Testing a dish today that doesn't feel heavy after. Tasting good is the easy part. Making 'em want to come back — that's the real trick.
dialogue.otherworldinn.story_gem_merchan: Thanks. The real value in any cargo is never what's on display — it's what survived inside the chest.
Fine. A merchant doesn't live or die by one good wagon. What's left of these samples is still enough to hold a shop for a while.

Bandits didn't take my life, but they smashed my wagon and specimen chests to bits. If you can spare eight leather, twelve string, and six iron ingots, I can at least get the most important compartments packed first.
Doesn't need a ton of ore. As long as it looks like there's scale, I'll get the picture.
No matter. Caution is part of trade. I'll sort through my own accounts first.

Sorted through my remaining samples and old accounts first, but that alone isn't enough. I need to know if this region is worth long-term goods. If you've been down the caves, bring me a photo. I want to see if the ore here is just luck or the foundation of real trade.

You didn't add much this time, but I won't leave empty-handed. Take the star core. A sharp eye doesn't always close the deal — but I know who deserves to see my reserves. I'll keep moving till somewhere fits.
Ledger and specimen cases have all been sorted through again. Whether this trip made enough or not, at least the accounts are clear. Time to decide what comes next for this business.
That'll do. My cases are fixed, and the ore veins look decent. Take this star core — it's the kind of piece I'd never put on a counter. Call it thanks, and a little trust I'm placing here.

Almost, but not enough. You helped save part of my capital and showed me this place has some promise — but not enough to stake all my ledgers. Take this star core. I'll keep comparing prices elsewhere.
Been reorganizing stock I'd never have displayed lightly before. People here don't just look at price tags — that's rare enough to appreciate.
Reconciling a few old accounts today. The hardest part of trade isn't spotting what's valuable — it's spotting who and where is worth handing valuable things to.
dialogue.otherworldinn.story_minstrel_st: Perfect. Songs — if you don't write 'em down quick, they're gone by the time you turn around.
It's fine. I can still come up with a few lines without paper. Just have to run 'em through my head a few more times.
Got a bunch of songs from the road, but I'm almost out of paper and ink. Can you spare five sheets and an ink sac? I'll sing you something new next time.
Don't overthink it. Just somewhere open — looks like it still has room for a new story.
No worries. Some songs get better if you let 'em sit. Next time.
Heard so much wind on this trip. Just missing one image to lock down the chorus. If you pass through the plains, can you snap a wide-open shot for me? Might finally wrap this one up.
Still missing one breath this time. No big deal — people miss each other sometimes, same with songs. I'll keep moving. When it really comes together, we'll talk.
Every bit of help you've given me along the way — I remember it all. The paper and ink you lent, the plains photo you brought back — it all pushes me to sing this one through to the end.

You're right. I've been drifting so long I almost forgot — a good song doesn't have to be finished on the road. Keep this disc for now. Once I get the rest sorted, I'll come back and sing it for you, no rush.

Song's written, but my feet aren't done yet. Keep the disc — think of it as the part I haven't sung, leaving it with you for now. Once I wander a bit more and fill in the rest, maybe I'll circle back this way someday.
I kinda like slowing down now. The voices here, cups clinking, the evening breeze — they keep better time for a chorus than the road ever did.
dialogue.otherworldinn.story_minstrel_vi: Trying to find a melody for the lines I wrote a few days ago. The light here isn't harsh — good for slowly working a song.
dialogue.otherworldinn.story_noble_stage: Finally don't look like I just crawled out of the mud. I'll remember this favor.
Very well. If a name is held together by nothing but cloth and gilt, then perhaps there was little of it left to hold.
Let's be clear — I'm not asking for charity. But to be seen, one must look presentable. If you'd spare two gold ingots and sixteen bundles of white wool, I can at least not look pathetically shabby.
Don't need a good angle. I just want to see the windows, the walls — and whatever dignity hasn't crumbled yet.
Fair enough. Not everyone wants to go out of their way to look at a ruin that still hasn't finished falling.
There aren't many proper estates left on this continent. If you pass a woodland mansion, snap a photo for me. I want to see how much of the old grandeur still stands.

Good. Now that even the last bit of capital is secured, I should admit: this inn is far more dignified than I first gave it credit for. Take this old watch — it's watched too much pointless ceremony with me. Now you keep it.
Don't misunderstand. I'm not unwilling to leave. I'm just too tired to explain myself to another room full of strangers. This place at least has lamps, chairs, and dinners that aren't embarrassing.

I thought I was only passing through. But once you get used to someone lighting the lamps and opening the door, it's hard to call every morning an exile. Take this old watch. It's stayed with me too long. Someone else should keep the hour now.

I've thought a lot these past few days. Whatever shreds of the old grandeur remain, this name's foundation needs a place to rebuild. Can you lend me four emeralds and a diamond? I'll keep a strict account.
Lately I've been learning to live like a resident, not someone waiting for the past to come back and apologize. Honestly, this place is surprisingly livable.
dialogue.otherworldinn.story_noble_visit: That bell in the front hall — it sounds more like proper living than most old estates ever did. Not about nostalgia. It's just finally quiet enough.
dialogue.otherworldinn.story_old_knight_: That'll do. When you're old, getting your old gear settled right can be harder than any battle.
So be it. An old soldier learns to stand even with pieces missing.

My shield still holds, but the straps, edging, and surcoat are falling apart. If you'd lend me six iron ingots, four leather, and eight bundles of red wool, I can at least get this old kit back in order.
Took another look through my old kit these past few days. Fixed what I could, carried the rest. Once you slow down, you start wondering which path feels right next.
Very well. Take this old shield — it's weathered plenty for me. If it's still got use, I'd rather it guard somewhere worth coming back to.
Not ready to set the armor aside yet. That's fine. Old soldiers keep walking. If I ever truly tire of it, I'll knock on your door.

Few days of rest and these old bones finally ache a little less. When you get old, you stop wanting to wear yourself out on the road. All those heavy thoughts from before — today feels right to put them down.
Been teaching myself mornings with no horn calling you up. Strange thing — these slow inn days feel rarer than a lot of victories.
Fresh stock from my travels. What are you looking for?
Rare goods from distant lands — see anything you like?
dialogue.otherworldinn.wandering_trader_: Fresh stock from my travels. What are you looking for?
Cold as it is, your vigil here is quite the lively one. Care to look around?
Fresh stock from my travels. What are you looking for?
So many grain ships in the harvest harbor. Anything you'd like?
Fresh stock from my travels. What are you looking for?
Night markets everywhere this season, but yours is the liveliest. Come have a look.
Fresh stock from my travels. What are you looking for?
Rare luck, docking right at the spring festival — the town's buzzing. Care to see my wares?

jei.otherworldinn.facility_upgrade_templ: Right-click within a facility to repair or upgrade it, consuming materials and coins.
jei.otherworldinn.inn_key.info: Sneak + right-click a Create Desk Bell within the inn area to toggle the inn between open and closed.

jei.otherworldinn.land_deed.info: Right-click a block to set the first corner, right-click again to set the opposite corner, and a third time to confirm and pay. It costs 2 coins per block, and areas already inside the inn are not charged again. The expandable area is limited by the inn rating; a higher rating allows a larger expansion. The selection is cancelled automatically if it goes beyond the allowed region.
jei.otherworldinn.messy_bed_sheet.info: Hold right-click while looking at water, a waterlogged block, or a cauldron to wash it clean. Washing in a cauldron has a 50% chance to not consume durability.

jei.otherworldinn.organic_fertilizer.inf: Right-click to trigger one random tick on the target block, letting it fertilize crops that vanilla bone meal cannot, such as sugar cane and cactus, and also speed up grass spread.
jei.otherworldinn.picnic_box.info: Right-click to eat the first food stored inside the box. Only food eaten from the picnic box restores fatigue. Food can only be inserted in the Town or Magic Space dimensions; you cannot refill it while exploring. Each use has a 15-second cooldown. Sneak + left-click to empty the box and return the food to your inventory.
jei.otherworldinn.recall_scroll.info: You get one automatically when leaving the Town. Hold right-click for 3 seconds to teleport back to the Town inn. Cannot be used while inside the Town; works from any other dimension, such as the Nether or the End.
jei.otherworldinn.room_key.info: Right-click a block inside a room to bind the key to that room. Right-click a waiting guest to check them into the bound room, consuming one key. It fails if the room is full or the guest has already checked in or out. Left-click a block inside the room to unbind the key.
jei.otherworldinn.room_register.info: Hold it in the off-hand and right-click one corner of a room, then the opposite corner. When conditions are met (size within limits and at least one bed and one door), the room is created automatically. Right-click with the main hand to show the current room count and highlight the room outline.
jei.otherworldinn.space_sphere.info: Using it unlocks map-point teleportation for the whole team, letting you click map markers directly in the Town map view to teleport to the destination.
